about: The labelled recordings the checks' numbers were set against. The files are private captures of the game and are not in the repository: --root names the folder they are kept in. 'faults' lists the checks that must fail a recording; without it the recording must pass. 'menu' leaves the play-only checks out, as the log does in a run. 'mask' is 'touch' for a recording with the app's touch controls on it. A whole run has its 'log', the 'offset' of its recording in the run, and its scenario's 'play_from' and 'combat_from' (report.json has them).
